mapper.select: SELECT i_idx, u_idx, i_category, i_title, i_status, DATE_FORMAT(i_created, '%Y.%m.%d') AS i_created FROM inquiries WHERE u_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY i_created DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i_idx, u_idx, i_category, i_title, i_content, i_status, i_answer, DATE_FORMAT(i_created, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS i_created, DATE_FORMAT(i_answered, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS i_answered FROM inquiries WHERE i_idx = #{inqIdx}
